description:
Save the original FIT file of an activity to the server's exports folder and return its path, e.g. to import it into another tool (Intervals.icu, Golden Cheetah, a spreadsheet converter).

The file is exactly what the device recorded. Saved as <data dir>/exports/<activity_id>.fit; an existing export is kept, not overwritten. For a multisport leg, exports the whole multisport file.
name: garmin_download_activity_fit
title: Export activity FIT file
